newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico says no date set to renew economic pact.
newsitem.headline: Mexico says no date set to renew economic pact.

text.p: Mexican Commerce Minister Herminio Blanco said on Wednesday the government has not yet set a date to renew its economic plan known as the Alliance for Economic Recovery (ARE).
"No date has yet been set for renewal of the Alliance," Blanco told reporters after inaugurating the Center for Development of Business Competitiveness in Mexico City.
He said the pact would remain in force for now and he discounted rumors of imminent hikes in the prices of milk and tortillas.
-- Maria Luisa Aguilar, Mexico City newsroom 525 7289565
